acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Elementals family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Elemental Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Four-Facet Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Tall complete hovering figure with exactly two coherent arms, a four-facet central core, four orbital vanes, a tapering lower body, and an affinity-built arena wake.

Signature mechanic: Arena Transformation — Fourfold Lattice: four core facets successively invoke Trace Drift, Tether Reach, Twin Conduit, and Mantle Orbit; resolving a pattern permanently dims its facet and weakens the final lattice.
battlefieldDuty: Transform the arena through four binding patterns that recombine every lower-form lesson.
constructionDimensions: Ochre-brown and umber earth magic forms the complete body from circulating soil, clay, silt, and fine mineral grains held in the family's flame-like contours.

Motion compresses, folds, and settles downward; load-bearing mineral seams and restrained pale-ochre faults articulate channels, mantle sections, and core facets without turning the form into a Golem.
counterplay: Resolve the announced lower-form lesson and strike the outward-facing facet; every dimmed facet removes one pattern from the final transformation. Affinity signal: A loaded seam compacts, hairline faults spread, and the seed, channel gap, mantle shutter, or sovereign facet loosens after the committed action.
forbiddenTreatments: Embers, smoke, char, lava, or molten rock
A solid rock projectile or ordinary masonry body
Brown palette without earthen material behavior
identityInvariants: Every form is organized around one readable binding seed or core, with no flesh, worn armor, ordinary clothing, handheld weapon, or fixed face.
The T1 Wisp is a small asymmetric teardrop or flame-like shape without limbs; T2–T5 develop a legless hovering upper body with exactly two coherent arm channels and a tapering lower body.
Affinity substance forms the complete load-bearing body, limbs, mantle, and directional wake rather than appearing as a colored exterior aura or decorative overlay.
Form coherence, core structure, and spatial control progress from one wandering Wisp to a four-facet Sovereign while the active telegraph and exposed counterplay remain readable.
telegraph: One of four core facets turns outward, its matching orbital vane aligns with the arena, and the lower-form silhouette appears within the selected path.
